notes: Flat vector, saturated colors, night-blue and sky backgrounds. Explain it with light splitting into colors, molecules and waves: the blue one bounces, the red one goes through.

scenes.label: Ciencia en 30 s
scenes.title: ¿Por qué el cielo es azul?
scenes.visual: sky, sun, clouds and sea; an arrow from the sea to the sky that gets crossed out

scenes.label: La luz del sol
scenes.title: Lleva todos los colores
scenes.visual: a white ray enters a prism and a fan of colors comes out

scenes.label: En el aire
scenes.title: Choca con moléculas diminutas
scenes.visual: floating molecules; colored waves arrive and hit them

scenes.label: Onda corta
scenes.title: La luz azul rebota más
scenes.visual: a short blue wave and a long red one; the blue one bounces in every direction, the red one keeps going

scenes.label: Por eso
scenes.title: Lo azul llega de todas partes
scenes.visual: a person on a hill; blue arrows reach them from all over the sky

scenes.label: Bonus
scenes.title: Al atardecer llegan los naranjas
scenes.visual: the sun goes down, the light crosses a longer layer of air, the blue gets lost on the way and the sky turns orange
